== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rogue 3 (Japanese)|Rogue 3]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/148375112/UI_3cTLygEuRsUxZQBr1EQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 82917285.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>fd9acb8633b9b24c06cdd4f18d29060b6bf54f71d7811f5d4295b98ba802f751</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
